help.eyebrow: A little order, a lot more memory
help.title: Help center
help.description: What you can do now and how your data is stored.
help.meaningBody: Add a word, language pair and precise translation. The source sentence helps you remember. When the same spelling already exists, choose whether to add context to an existing meaning or create a new one.
help.practiceBody: The server issues and validates every question. Flashcards use self-rating; recall, spelling and matching receive a server score. Audio and pronunciation appear only when a provider supports the language.
help.accountBody: A real account is authenticated by rbase Core. Words, sessions, learning evidence, XP and preferences are saved in GotIt Backend. The demo is available only when the site operator explicitly enables it.
help.privacyBody: Deletion is soft and a word can be restored. A pronunciation recording is created only when you press the button, converted temporarily to WAV and sent to the server for evaluation; it is not stored in browser storage.
help.tokenBody: The access token is kept in memory and the refresh token in the tab's session storage. Answers are sent with a stable event ID for safe retries.
help.authDescription: Email, Google and Facebook are connected to Core
help.mediaDescription: The interfaces are connected; actual availability depends on server providers and language support
help.transferDescription: Connected to the server's versioned formats
help.passwordDescription: Not implemented in the current Core version
